SELECT lot_id lotId,earn_ledger_id earnLedgerId,original_points originalPoints, available_points availablePoints,frozen_points frozenPoints,policy_version policyVersion, expires_at expiresAt,version FROM mbr_points_lot WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND lot_id=#{lotId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT lot_id lotId,earn_ledger_id earnLedgerId,original_points originalPoints, available_points availablePoints,frozen_points frozenPoints,policy_version policyVersion, expires_at expiresAt,version FROM mbr_points_lot WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND member_id=#{memberId} AND available_points>0 AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at>#{occurredAt}) ORDER BY CASE WHEN expires_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,expires_at,occurred_at,lot_id FOR UPDATE

SELECT original.lot_id lotId,original.points frozenPoints,COALESCE(SUM(released.points),0) releasedPoints, lot.expires_at expiresAt FROM mbr_points_allocation original JOIN mbr_points_lot lot ON lot.tenant_id=original.tenant_id AND lot.lot_id=original.lot_id LEFT JOIN mbr_points_allocation released ON released.tenant_id=original.tenant_id AND released.parent_ledger_id=original.ledger_id AND released.lot_id=original.lot_id AND released.allocation_type IN ('SPEND','UNFREEZE') WHERE original.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND original.ledger_id=#{freezeLedgerId} AND original.allocation_type='FREEZE' GROUP BY original.lot_id,original.points,lot.expires_at HAVING original.points>COALESCE(SUM(released.points),0) ORDER BY CASE WHEN lot.expires_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,lot.expires_at,original.lot_id

SELECT spent.lot_id lotId,spent.points spentPoints,COALESCE(SUM(restored.points),0) restoredPoints, lot.expires_at sourceExpiresAt FROM mbr_points_allocation spent JOIN mbr_points_lot lot ON lot.tenant_id=spent.tenant_id AND lot.lot_id=spent.lot_id LEFT JOIN mbr_points_allocation restored ON restored.tenant_id=spent.tenant_id AND restored.parent_ledger_id=spent.ledger_id AND restored.lot_id=spent.lot_id AND restored.allocation_type='RETURN_SPEND_REVERSAL' WHERE spent.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND spent.ledger_id=#{spendLedgerId} AND spent.allocation_type='SPEND' GROUP BY spent.lot_id,spent.points,lot.expires_at HAVING spent.points>COALESCE(SUM(restored.points),0) ORDER BY spent.lot_id
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) FROM mbr_points_ledger WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND original_ledger_id=#{originalLedgerId} AND event_type=#{reversalType}

SELECT history_id historyId,member_id memberId,level_code levelCode,policy_version policyVersion, reason_code reasonCode,store_id storeId,business_date businessDate,actor_user_id actorUserId, approval_user_id approvalUserId,approval_ref approvalRef,effective_at effectiveAt FROM mbr_level_history WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND member_id=#{memberId} ORDER BY effective_at DESC,history_id DESC LIMIT 1
